findings.element: Line Analysis DPM accordion — Actions cell of the Done rows (e.g. 'Linienanalyse DPM – Letztes Jahr, Kanton BE')
findings.finding: Three evaluations show a Done status chip but carry a delete action only, so no control anywhere opens their report.
findings.user_impact: A user whose evaluation finished successfully cannot reach the result they came for, is given no reason why, and is left with deleting or re-running as the only available moves.
findings.suggested_fix: Give Done Line Analysis rows the same preview action as the other Done groups, or render an explicit inline reason in the Actions cell where the control would otherwise sit.

evidence.action: Expanded the Line Analysis DPM accordion and inspected the Actions cell of every row carrying a Done status chip
evidence.observed: All three Done rows render only the delete icon — no preview eye and no download; the state map's action set records done:line_analysis = 'delete', and data.js rows 157-207 confirm actions: ['delete'] on each of them, while done:punctuality, done:data_quality and done:connection all carry visibility.

findings.element: Download icon on Done Raw Data Export rows
findings.finding: The download action reports 'Download started …' in a snackbar but never produces a file or any follow-up state.
findings.user_impact: The user believes their export is on its way, waits or navigates away, and the result never arrives with nothing on screen indicating that it failed.
findings.suggested_fix: Deliver the file, and replace the fire-and-forget message with a terminal state that resolves to ready or failed so the row's outcome is observable.

evidence.action: Clicked the download icon on a Done Raw Data Export row
evidence.observed: A snackbar reads 'Download started …' and nothing further happens — no file, no progress, no completion or failure state; app.js:319 calls notify() only, with no download side effect.

findings.element: Top bar nav items — Startseite / Q.Reports / Fotoalbum / Q-Messungen
findings.finding: Four global nav items render as enabled buttons with hover and click feedback but have no handler and no destination.
findings.user_impact: Users click them expecting navigation, receive positive click feedback with no result, and click again — the dead-click pattern KF-4 records as the densest in the product.
findings.suggested_fix: Disable them with a short 'not part of this prototype' tooltip, or remove them, so nothing in the global nav accepts a click it cannot honour.

evidence.action: Clicked each of the four top-bar nav items in turn
evidence.observed: Nothing happens — no navigation and no message; app.js:1435-1449 renders them as MUI Buttons at opacity .75 with no onClick and no disabled prop, so they remain hoverable and still produce a click ripple.

findings.element: Evaluation name cell in every group table
findings.finding: The evaluation name is inert text, so the only route into a report is a small right-aligned eye icon that some rows have and others do not.
findings.user_impact: Users scanning the list click the name — the object they actually care about — get no response, and have to discover that the real control sits at the far right edge of the row.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the name the primary open control on rows that have a report, leaving names without one as plain text, so the affordance matches what the row can actually do.

evidence.action: Clicked the name of a Done evaluation in the Punctuality DPM table, then opened the same evaluation from its row action
evidence.observed: The name does nothing (app.js:306 renders it as a bare TableCell) and the report opened only from the right-edge preview icon; the name column is identically non-interactive on rows that have a report and rows that do not, so it signals neither.

findings.element: Login screen — 'Forgot your password?' link and the Impressum / Dokumente / Kontaktdaten / Support utility bar
findings.finding: All five links on the sign-in screen are inert — the password link preventDefaults to nowhere and the four utility links carry an open-in-new icon with no target.
findings.user_impact: A user who cannot sign in, or who needs the legally required Impressum, hits a silent dead end on the one screen where no alternative route exists.
findings.suggested_fix: Point the links at real destinations or a short 'not available in this prototype' message, and drop the open-in-new icon wherever nothing opens.

evidence.action: Clicked 'Forgot your password?' and then each of the four utility-bar links on the sign-in screen
evidence.observed: Nothing happens and no message appears in either case; app.js:1542-1545 shows href='#' with onClick preventDefault, and the utility links render the open-in-new affordance with no destination behind it.

gaps: New evaluation: Run is on the state map's not_exercised list, so the second half of the primary task ('or start a new one') has no recorded commit — whether a new evaluation lands in the list, and in which group and status, is unknown.

Report views beyond the first screen are listed as not_exercised, so what the user can do once the preview action opens a report — including whether any route back to the list exists — is not recorded, and the open half of the primary task is therefore only verified as far as the report's first paint.

Delete on in-progress and running rows: the map records the delete icon as present on every row but never records clicking it on a row still in flight, so whether it is blocked, disabled, or destroys running work is unknown; the port's row rendering (app.js:313-327) applies no disabled state, which suggests the vanilla's H15 fix did not carry over — raised as a gap rather than filed as a finding, since H15 is on the resolved list.

No loading state is recorded anywhere — not for opening a report, not for applying a filter, and not for the in-progress and running rows themselves; KF-1 asks whether long-running operations show real progress, and a status chip with no progress, no ETA and no recorded refresh path was never exercised.
No error state is recorded for any control except login validation; the map covers the 'No evaluations found' empty state but nothing shows what the list does when its data fails to load.
